title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport; Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital
summary: Saudi Arabia reported flames and smoke near Riyadh airport following Houthi claims of attacks on the capital. The kingdom had issued overnight alerts warning of potential dangers amid an escalating campaign of attacks. The incident highlights ongoing regional tensions and threats to critical infrastructure.
content: Saudi Arabia had sent alerts overnight warning of potential danger around Riyadh, amid an escalation in attacks by the Houthis in the kingdom.

title: Trump says he will appoint a new AI adviser, without providing details
summary: Former President Trump announced plans to appoint a new AI adviser but provided no additional details about the role or timing. Trump has previously downplayed concerns about artificial intelligence and opposed additional regulation of the technology. The appointment signals a potential policy direction on AI governance.
content: Trump has repeatedly downplayed concerns about AI and argued that additional regulation is unnecessary.

zh.title: 特朗普表示将任命新的人工智能顾问，但未提供详细信息
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普宣布计划任命新的人工智能顾问，但未提供有关职位或时间的任何额外细节。特朗普此前曾淡化人工智能的担忧，并反对对该技术进行额外监管。这一任命预示着人工智能治理政策的潜在走向。

title: 90% of retirees are making this miscalculation with their savings
summary: Retirees often overlook how the sequence of their spending affects both taxes and life satisfaction. Optimizing the order of withdrawals can significantly minimize tax burden and improve retirement quality of life.

title: The future of retirement? Work until you die.

title: These are the 10 biggest retirement fears — and what you can do about them
summary: Financial security alone cannot eliminate retirement anxieties, with concerns persisting across all wealth levels. Understanding the top 10 retirement fears provides a roadmap for developing effective strategies to address common worries.

title: What happens if you never buy a house? What renters are gaining — and giving up.
summary: Soaring home prices are driving young adults to reconsider homeownership as a wealth-building strategy. Renters are now weighing the tradeoffs between avoiding house purchase costs and missing out on property equity accumulation.

zh.title: 如果你永远不买房会怎样？租房者的收获与失去

title: Higher interest rates and AI safety fears put the stock market to the test last week

title: U.S. judge signals rejection of part of TikTok $400 million privacy settlement

The ruling could impact the tech company's settlement with regulators.
content: TikTok agreed to pay $300 million and a further $100 million if a court terminated a 2019 consent decree imposed by the FTC on TikTok's predecessor, Musical.ly.

zh.title: 美国法官暗示拒绝批准TikTok 4亿美元隐私和解案的部分内容
